newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Danbury, Conn.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Danbury, Conn.

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the City of Danbury, Connecticut, at City Hall, Common Council Caucus Room, 4th Floor, Room 432, 155 Deer Hill Avenue, Danbury, Connecticut, subject to the provisions of the official Notice of Sale dated July 17, 1997.
Maturities: $510,000 on August 1 in each of the year 1998-2007,
both inclusive, and $500,000 on August 1 in
February 1 and August 1 in each year until

The Bonds shall NOT be designated by the City as qualified tax exempt obligations under the provisions of Section 265 (b) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, for purposes of the deduction by financial institutions for interest expense allocable to the Bonds.

For copies of the official Notice of Sale, the Official Statement of the City of Danbury, Connecticut, dated July 17, 1997, and bid form, please contact Mr. Richard G. Christensen, Vice President, People's Bank, Municipal
Banking and Finance, 850 Main Street, Bridgeport,
